reviewedPatterns.absorbedPattern: research and outline before long-form drafting
separate reference integrity from claim support
deterministic prose checks as a future gate

redGreenEvidence.initialBrowserFailure: Conservative polish was misrouted to Tools and treated preservation of existing citation keys as a new evidence request.
redGreenEvidence.rootCause: A bare Chinese word for command triggered tool execution, while any citation mention triggered citation-sensitive writing.
redGreenEvidence.fix: Require executable intent for command routing and distinguish preservation-only citation language from citation creation or verification.

limitations: No real model was invoked, so generated prose quality was not measured.
No productivity percentage is claimed without a real-user baseline and review record.
Deterministic prose linting, external citation-integrity checks, and multi-format export remain roadmap items.
